Compare a bounded cloud presence window with this phone\u0027s local ledger. Cloud presence adds a record of when play happened, even while Backlogium is closed. Recovered shared-game sessions update observed time and progress without retroactive celebrations. Backlogium functions fully without it. It never imports Steam lifetime playtime or invents unobserved time.

Session starts are approximate because play is discovered by periodic polls. The tracked minutes come from changes observed in the Steam playtime counter, so they can differ from the Steam lifetime total change. These are two honest measurements, not an exact start-to-end interval or a sign that data was lost.

Automatic · daily opportunity and play ends

Automatic has a daily background opportunity and can also catch up after play ends, with at least 12 hours between routine starts. Other choices set the minimum gap for both opportunities. These limits apply only to routine phone reads, not the cloud poller’s minute observations, manual Read now, or cloud evidence reads needed to place Steam minutes. They do not cap all cloud requests.
